definitions.short: to run after (usually with hostile intent; figuratively [of time] gone by )
definitions.usage: chase, put to flight, follow (after, on), hunt, (be under) persecute(-ion, -or), pursue(-r).
definitions.full: H7291. radaph רָדַף 141 verb pursue, chase, persecute (Late Hebrew id. , Aramaic רְדַף , ; Arabic ; Sabean רדף id. , SabDenkm No. 7, 1. 2 ); — Qal 128 Perfect 3masculine singular ׳ר Judg 4:16 +; 1 singular וְרָדַפְתִּ֫י Jer 29:18 , etc.; Imperfect יִרְדֹּף Deut 19:6 +, ִירַדֹּף Psa 7:6 (apparently to give choice of Qal or Pi, Ki JHMich Bae and others; Ges § 63n explanation as developed from יִרֲדֹף , compare Ol § 236 e, and, further , Kö i. 160 ), suffix דְָּפֶ֑ךָ יִרְ Ezek 35:6 (twice in verse), etc.; Imperative masculine singular רְדֹף Gen 44:4 +, suffix רָדְפֵהוּ Psa 34:15 ; masculine plural רִדְפוּ Judg 3:28 +; Infinitive construct רָדְפִף Josh 8:16 +, מִרְדֹף 1Sam 23:28 ; 2Sam 18:16 , suffix רָדְפִי Psa 38:21 Qr, רדופי Kt, etc.; Participle רֹדֵף Judg 4:22 +, plural רֹדְפִים 8:4 +; — 1. a. pursue (sometimes + הִשִּׂיג ): literal with אַחֲרֵי person, in order to overtake Gen 44:4 (J), 2Kin 5:21 ; especially with hostile purpose Gen 31:23 (+ הִדְבִּיק ), 35:5 ; Josh 24:6 (all E), 2:5 , 7 (twice in verse); 8:16 (twice in verse); 8:17 ; 10:19 (JE), Deut 11:4 ; 19:6 ; Josh 20:5 (all D), Exod 14:4 , 8 , 9 (P), Judg 1:6 ; 2Sam 20:6-7 , 10 , 13 ; 2Kin 9:27 17 t., + 25:5 ( אַחַר ), + Judg 4:16 ( הָרֶכֶב אַחֲרֵי ); + אַחֲרֵי רִדְפוּ 3:28 = follow me (as leader; but this meaning not elsewhere; read ᵐ5 רְדוּ Kit GFM). b. literal, with accusative of person, put to flight, chase (defeated foe; sometimes with הִשִּׁיג ): Amos 1:11 ; Hosea 8:3 ; Deut 32:30 (poem; || הֵנִיס ), 28:22 , 45 ; Josh 23:10 (D), Lev 26:8 (twice in verse) (H); נִדָּף עָלֶה קוֺל אֹתָם וְרָדַף 26:36 a (H); Josh 7:5 ; 8:24 ; 10:10 ; 11:8 (all J E), Gen 14:15 ; Deut 1:44 ; Judg 4:22 ; Isa 41:3 13 t. + Judg 7:25 (read אֶתֿ for ᵑ7 ᵑ9 ᵐ5 אֶלֿ, GFM Bu Now). c. literal, accusative omitted Judg 8:4 ; 1Sam 30:8 (+ הִשִּׂיג ), 30:10 ; Gen 14:14 ; Exod 14:23 (P), 15:9 (poem; + הִשִּׂיג ), Lev 26:36 b. 37 (H), Prov 28:1 ; especially participle plural ׳הָר the pursuers Josh 2:16 (twice in verse); 2:22 (twice in verse); Neh 9:11 ; Isa 30:16 , so הָרֹדֵף Josh 8:20 ; Lam 1:6 . d. chase, hunt , partridge ( קֹרֵא ) 1Sam 26:20 (in simile; || בִּקֵּשׁ ). e. pursue , in figure, Jer 20:11 ; Lam 4:19 , וְתִפְשׂוּהוּ רִדְפוּ Psa 71:11 , compare Lam 1:3 ; Psa 7:6 (+ הִשִּׂיג ; see above); especially subject ׳י , pursue (figurative of punishment, judgment), with accusative of person Jer 29:18 ( בַּחֶרֶב ), Lam 3:43 and ( בְּאַף ) 3:66 , Psa 83:16 ( בְּסַעֲרֶ֑ךָ ); תִּרְדֹּף יָבֵשׁ אֶתקַֿשׁ Job 13:25 (|| תַּעַרוֺץ ); רֹדְפָם , of י ׳מַלְאַךְ , Psa 35:6 . f. figurative persecute, harass , with accusative of person Deut 30:7 ; Job 19:22 ( כְּמוֺאֵֿל ), Psa 69:27 ; 109:16 ; 119:86 ; 119:161 ; with accusative נַפְשִׁי 143:3 , with accusative נֲדִבָתִי Job 30:15 (but subject obscure; read perhaps תֵּרָדֵף Bu; Du תִּנָּדֵף ); with ל person 19:28 ; participle as substantive Jer 15:15 ; 17:18 ; Psa 7:2 ; 31:16 (|| אוֺיְבַי ; We מְרַדְּפָ֑י for וַרֹדְפָ֑י ), 35:3 ; 119:84 ; 119:157 (+ צָרַי ), 142:7 . g. pursue, dog , subject דָּם , with accusative of person Ezek 35:6 (twice in verse) (del v a ᵐ5 Co Toy Krae); in good sense, attend closely upon , יִרְדְּפוּנִי וָחֶסֶד טוֺב Psa 23:6 . 2 figurative follow after, aim to secure: in bad sense, with accusative שַׁלְמֹנִים Isa 1:23 , שֵׁכָר 5:11 , ׳ר קָדִים Hosea 12:2 , זִמָּה רֹדְפֵי Psa 119:150 ; good sense, with infinitive אֶתיֿ ׳לְדַעַת Hosea 6:3 , with accusative צֶדֶק Deut 16:20 ; Isa 51:1 (|| י ׳מְבַקְשֵׁי ), וָחָ֑סֶד צְדָקָה Prov 21:21 , שָׁלוֺם Psa 34:15 (|| בַּוֵּשׁ ), טוֺב 38:21 . Niph`al passive: Perfect 1plural נִרְדָּ֑פְנוּ עַלצַֿוָּארֵנוּ Lam 5:5 upon our neck (i.e. closely) we are pursued (improbable, compare Bu); perhaps Imperfect 3feminine singular תֵּרָדֵף Job 30:15 Bu (for תִּרְדֹּף ); Participle אֶתנִֿרְדָּ֑ף יְבַקֵּשׁ ׳א Eccl 3:15 God seeketh the pursued (i.e. what has disappeared, is past, but dubious). Pi`el Perfect 3feminine singular consecutive וְרִדְּפָה Hosea 2:9 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular יְרַדֶּףֿ Nahum 1:8 ( Psa 7:6 see Qal ); 3 feminine singular תְּרַדֵּף Prov 13:21 ; Participle מְרֵדֵּףֿ 11:19 +; — pursue ardently , with accusative of person Hosea 2:9 (in figurative); figurative also ׳יְר חשֶׁךְ Nahum 1:8 (Gunk ZAW xiii (1893), 230 , plausibly, יֶהְדֹּף ), compare Proverbs 13:31; elsewhere participle, in Proverbs: aim (eagerly) to secure , with accusative רָעָה Prov 11:19 , רֵיקִים 12:11 ; 28:19 , אֲמָרִים 19:7 (meaning dubious, see Toy); in good sense, צְדָקָה 15:9 . Pu`al Perfect 3masculine singular consecutive הָרִים כְמֹץ וְרֻדַּף Isa 17:13 it shall be chased away like chaff of the mountains (|| וְנָס ). Hiph`il Perfect 3masculine singular suffix הִרְּדִיפֻהוּ Judg 20:43 usually they chased him (Benjamin, collective), but strange after כִתְּרוּ surrounded (still stranger after כתתו or ᵐ5 כרתו ), and why Hiph`il? GFM conjecture dittograph of הִדְרִיכֻהוּ following; the reverse conjectured by Bu Now.
